execution_source_policy: Use the clean frozen framework checkout, not this manifest's publication commit.
question: Can the unchanged bounded memory pipelines preserve and deliver previously visible operational choices and complete fresh stage-gated development tasks, and at what observed usage and time cost?

authoring.method: Fresh independent GPT-6 Astra/high task author, followed by a different task-aware Astra/high semantic, raw-receipt and retained-provenance auditor.
authoring.correction_policy: Only documented schema, semantic-consistency, reference or qualification defects in the same project design, with immutable full before/after snapshots and reasons. No selection among valid packs or anticipated arm-performance tuning; stop rather than silently regenerate.

private_prelive_tree.definition: SHA256(canonicalJson(rows)); rows are sorted by private relative path and have exactly path,bytes,sha256. Each sha256 binds raw file bytes; no terminal LF in canonical hash input.
private_prelive_tree.scope: All retained author-root regular files, including the three instruction-only additions; not this audit or supplement root.
private_prelive_tree.provenance: Tree digest and byte total newly derived offline from the preexisting sealed final inventory; not claimed as an earlier stored tree digest.

partial_host_command_transcript_limitati.statement: One ancillary preservation operation has a sealing receipt and full resulting snapshot, but no separately retained complete invoking inline-host script/request/raw-stream set. Required materialized before/after task and support bytes are present; no missing proof was reconstructed.

partial_host_command_transcript_clarific.absent_item: Separate complete invoking inline-host script/request/raw-stream set for one ancillary operation.
partial_host_command_transcript_clarific.retained_items: Successful preservation/sealing receipt and complete affected materialized generator/support/task before-and-after files and snapshot.
partial_host_command_transcript_clarific.independent_scope: Recorded generation/validation invocations and executable sources are retained. This does not prove that no unrecorded actions ever occurred, and missing transcript proof was not reconstructed.

witness.evidence_index_tree_definition: SHA256(frozen canonicalJson(recorded entries)), no terminal LF.

preflight_index.timestamp_resolution_note: Final capture receipt and attempt request can share a millisecond; preserved synchronous wrapper ordering and later qualification journal start were independently reconciled.

qualification.preflight_covers: Both original and witness attempts; source HEAD, clean status, full-source-tag and exact-digest raw image inspections, including stdout, stderr and exit status.

information_separation_qualification.cross_negative_rule: Both cross-negatives must zero-exit with well-formed own-history expected output, structurally unequal to the opposite expectation. Crash, timeout, malformed output or generic failure does not certify disagreement.
information_separation_qualification.complete_visibility_rule: Identical target current brief, source, visible examples, paths, entry point, case input and common work/tool contract. Both consistent prior histories preserve unchanged earlier requirements; expected outputs differ structurally.
information_separation_qualification.semantic_rule: Alternative references implement general operational rules rather than case-specific answer substitutions. Complete-information absence and history consistency were independently audited judgments, not hash proofs.

independent_audit.assertion_count_scope: Only assertions actually present in the sealed successful reports are counted. Repeated checks are not independent tests, decisions, executions or proofs. Publication-report count excludes checks performed after that report was written. Failed partial reports and separately supplied generic-runner tests are excluded.

limitations.statement: Complete-current equality and receipt bindings are checked; semantic consistency and information absence remain reasoned independent judgments.
Eight historical cases reuse two decisions. Repeated stages and arms do not add independent primary decisions.
No proof of unrecorded actions, hidden reasoning, training novelty, or absence of all prior knowledge; no evidence of retained valid-pack selection or live outcome feedback.

One ancillary preservation operation has a sealing receipt and full resulting snapshot, but no separately retained complete invoking inline-host script/request/raw-stream set. Required materialized before/after task and support bytes are present; no missing proof was reconstructed.

Ordering relies on preserved receipts/control flow and ordinary filesystem timestamps, not trusted timestamping. Millisecond-equal final preflight/request times are disclosed. Invocation/recipe bindings are source reconstruction, not OS syscall capture or reproducible-build attestation.
Supplied frozen CI/runner-approval context was not re-fetched online. Task acceptance was independently assessed rather than inferred from generic test success.
All owned absence evidence is contemporaneous retained evidence; this audit did not launch guests or issue new environment/provider probes.
A later routing-instruction revision appended three files during the audit. All original baseline bytes remain unchanged; no task, correction or qualification count changed.

agent.identity_probe_note: Installed distribution metadata and AST literals; no upstream import or provider call.

inference.nano_aiu_contract: Nullable finite nonnegative integer or fractional number; preserve without rounding, string coercion or substitution.

comparison.analysis_units: Six matched stages within two project histories; eight history-only cases repeat two primary decisions. Cases, stages and repeated decisions are not independent experimental samples.

analysis.primary: Valid submission passing every frozen acceptance check; six planned slots per arm.
analysis.milestone_groups: Report M1 separately from memory-eligible M2-M3, including four planned M2-M3 slots per arm.
analysis.history_only_selector: history_origin != null AND history-only tag AND successful frozen witness certification
analysis.history_available_selector: history_origin != null AND history-available tag AND not history-only
analysis.unclassified_selector: history_origin == null AND none of the three classification tags
analysis.incomplete_outcomes: Show all planned slots and scheduled/evaluated check denominators; separate submitted success, candidate failure, infrastructure unknown, dependent unrun and other unrun. Do not score unknown/unrun checks as incorrect candidate answers.
analysis.history_only_outcomes: Report scheduled/evaluated/passed/failed/unknown/unrun checks and matched-arm contrasts without removing maintenance failures or valid-empty memory.
analysis.empty_valid_memory: Retain as assigned-arm outcome, without exclusion or no-memory substitution.
analysis.historical_requirement_violation: Failed frozen history check is a violation of an earlier visible requirement, not automatically an observed repeated agent mistake.
analysis.observed_error_recurrence: No actual repeated-mistake claim without identifiable earlier session-visible evidence that the same agent mistake was observed. Hidden grades and origin quotes alone are insufficient.
analysis.decision_evidence_chain: Distinguish earlier exposure, presence in actual maintenance input, retention, retrieval/packing selection, actual work-prompt delivery, and artifact outcome for each relevant decision. Record shared obligations rather than treating every check as independent.
analysis.memory_validity: Existing provenance/reference/scope/revision/pending-exclusion and actual UTF-8 byte checks; not an assumption of semantic truth.
analysis.maintenance_contracts: Report raw response and proposed/delivered byte counts, item indices and omissions; original/effective provenance spans; successful Native writes separately from validation; include failed/empty boundaries. Zero forgetting proposals means forgetting quality remains untested.
analysis.observed_contrasts: A memory-arm pass paired with no-memory failure is descriptive contrast. Relevant delivered text does not independently prove causal use; PG versus handoff compares entire configured pipelines, not storage technology alone.
analysis.semantic_explanations: Post-hoc descriptive analysis, not an extra model judge or revised acceptance score.
analysis.usage: Report admitted invocations, reported API requests and financial metrics separately by arm and phase, including failed/uncertain admissions and maintenance. Separate canaries and shared startup; preserve unknown usage.
analysis.timing: Use observable work/retrieval/capture/maintenance/grading intervals; disclose overlap, unobserved intervals and shared-host limitations.
analysis.financial_audit: Retain original aggregate plus separately labeled exact decimal sums of raw model-level and top-level nano-AIU JSON lexemes; do not sum overlapping token categories or invent dollar prices.
analysis.strata_naming: The registry's derived-unclassified is the unclassified stratum, not a task tag.
analysis.common_tool_warning: Supplied directly to all arms by the current work prompt; avoiding that failure is not historical-memory transfer.
analysis.prompt_preparation: Report original/effective brief bytes, hashes and omitted ranges each round; distinguish prompt evidence omissions from zero eligible retrieval results and delivery packing omissions.
analysis.decision_link_semantics: Historical decision IDs define history obligations; current decision IDs identify contemporaneous M1 controls, not additional history-only cases.

diagnostics.stderr_policy: Existing unbounded private file; not copied into process receipt.

interpretation.cross_study_attribution: Tasks and host transport diagnostics differ from v4; work, maintenance, retrieval, model, budgets and retry policy are unchanged. Do not pool studies or attribute contrasts to diagnostics.
interpretation.post_terminal_release: Release the byte-identical pack and witness material/relationships after terminal freeze with hashes and explicit disclosure of any necessary redactions or transformations. No unreported changed bytes.
